label: Kubernetes' own answers to `kubectl auth can-i`, asked as each of Klaxon's two accounts on this Mac's kind cluster (week 6, item 4), each through its own kubeconfig with an hour's token, made by klaxon.patient.cluster. Asks only: no write was made. Then `kubectl rollout status` as klaxon-rollback, the one watch its rollback needs. Run by a script in Claude's scratch folder, not in the repo.
